title: GHSA-5mx8-mwrp-5693: Generated URLs Can Point to a Host Chosen by the Client
content:
<html><head></head><body>Affected versions
Symfony HTTP Foundation versions <5.4.56, >=6, <6.4.50, >=7, <7.4.23, >=8, <8.1.11 are affected by this security issue.
The issue has been fixed in Symfony HTTP Foundation 5.4.56, 6.4.50, 7.4.23, 8.1.11.
